# Bid the feet, the stories, and the mesh.

> Price a gutter guard install from extra stories, extra lineal feet, extra miters, extra downspouts, a clean-first pass, fascia repair, and steep-roof access — not a published $8/foot leaf-filter special. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper screen quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
